minimumReproduction.setup: Create principals p1/p2 and aliases a1/a2. Store canonicalPseudonymsByPrincipal[p1]=[a1], canonicalPseudonymsByPrincipal[p2]=[a2], but cross principalByCanonicalPseudonym to a1->p2 and a2->p1. Store only opaque attestation SHA-256 values and no custodian attestation objects.
minimumReproduction.operation: Call sealIdentityRegistry(registry), then validateRoleAssignmentIdentity for alias a1, principal p2, and p2's opaque attestation digest.
minimumReproduction.expected: Reject before sealing or assignment because the forward and reverse identity maps are not a bijection and the asserted principal/alias binding is not independently attested.
minimumReproduction.observed: The registry becomes ready=true and sealed=true, a root is returned, and the crossed a1->p2 role assignment returns true.

minimumReproduction.setup: Take the canonical Base64 encoding of 64 zero bytes and replace its final data character with each of A through P before the terminal == padding.
minimumReproduction.operation: Validate all 16 strings as identityCustodianAttestation records, decode them, then round-trip encode the decoded bytes.
minimumReproduction.expected: Accept exactly one canonical Base64 representation and reject the 15 aliases that decode to the same bytes.
minimumReproduction.observed: All 16 records are schema-valid and decode to the same 64 bytes; 15 fail canonical round-trip equality.

blockers.concern: recomputed policy versus caller-owned derived tuples

minimumReproduction.setup: Clone a valid sealed policy. Leave source policyRows unchanged. Mutate a derived MAIN_CERTIFICATION_PHASE1/RAW_PRIVATE_TRUSTED_GOLD tuple from DENY to ALLOW for PACKET_AUTHOR and replace its tuple/role roots plus the caller-owned matrix root.
minimumReproduction.operation: Build an authorization matching the mutated derived tuple and call validateAuthorizationAgainstPolicy.
minimumReproduction.expected: Use only tuples and roots returned by recomputing the immutable source policy; reject the caller-mutated derived tuple and roots.
minimumReproduction.observed: The seal recomputation checks only the original sealed root, then authorization rereads policyRegistry.tuples and policyRegistry.roots from the mutated caller object and returns true.

minimumReproduction.setup: Create a post-activation authorization that self-claims currentState=ACTIVATION_GRANTED and presents different_alias_0001 while its active role assignment records assignment_alias_0001. Do not supply an authoritative state-event chain or sealed identity registry to the validator.
minimumReproduction.operation: Call validateAuthorizationAgainstPolicy using only the caller-supplied authorization, policy registry, and role-assignment list.
minimumReproduction.expected: Derive current state from the authoritative event sequence and resolve the actor's current canonical alias from the sealed identity/assignment state; reject either mismatch.
minimumReproduction.observed: The function trusts authorization.currentState, never compares the presented alias with the assignment alias, and returns true.

blockers.concern: FOCUS_ONLY-to-ALL_25 scope escalation and hashes-only preexisting audit

minimumReproduction.setup: Build a candidate and two reviewer certificate claims with FOCUS_ONLY for GRAMMAR_ERROR and BLANK_INFERENCE. Build a grant with grantedCoverageEvidence=ALL_25. Reuse one opaque coverageRecomputationRoot scalar across candidate/audit/grant. Supply a preexistingAuditRecord made only of arbitrary well-formed hashes, monotone integer ordinals 10/11/11 before grant ordinal 12, and recordedBeforeGrant=true.
minimumReproduction.operation: Call validateGrantAgainstSealedPolicy without certificate event bodies, candidate/audit append-only sequence entries, or audit manifest/report content.
minimumReproduction.expected: Require grant scope to be a subset of the candidate request and every dereferenced certificate scope; dereference and canonicalize exact candidate/audit/manifest events from an authoritative append-only sequence and verify exact content and ordinals.
minimumReproduction.observed: No nested scope-subset check or event-body dereference occurs; the FOCUS_ONLY candidate produces an ALL_25 grant and hashes-only audit record is accepted, returning true.

minimumReproduction.setup: Place a valid derived composite fingerprint in an independent tombstone set and present the same composite again for reuse.
minimumReproduction.operation: Search the public semantics/fingerprint export surfaces for a reservation, tombstone, disjointness, or replay validator and attempt to identify a callable whole-registry invariant check.
minimumReproduction.expected: An exported validator must recompute fingerprint claims and reject any reservation/materialization/tombstone overlap or reuse across the authoritative registry lifecycle.
minimumReproduction.observed: The independent oracle identifies the replay in all 512 cases, but the subject exports no reservation/tombstone/disjointness/replay validator, so the lifecycle invariant is not enforceable through the public implementation.

minimumReproduction.setup: For each seed, create four individually schema-valid AUTHORIZATION, OPEN, CAPABILITY_CONSUME, and CLOSE records with different transaction IDs and capability tokens, nonconsecutive ordinals, mismatched event hashes, and reversed timestamps.
minimumReproduction.operation: Validate each record against its JSON Schema and search the public semantic exports for an access/transaction/capability/open/consume/close sequence validator.
minimumReproduction.expected: A semantic validator must reject the disconnected chain, bind one transaction and capability across all four events, enforce order and time monotonicity, and atomically prevent a second consume through authoritative capability state.
minimumReproduction.observed: All individual schemas accept each disconnected record in 1,024 constructed chains, and no matching semantic validator is exported.

failureSeal.reopenCondition: A new immutable successor subject must fix all seven blockers and pass a fresh independent audit. This sealed v4 subject cannot be accepted by reinterpretation of this report.
